none: PAS NLM-0C72DC: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), Emperor right issue of 364-378, possibly Arles or Lyon mint, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Diademed and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: [--]V[--]. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right dragging captive and holding labarum. [-]F in left field. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 16.5mm, Weight: 1.43gms, die axis: 6
